en.topic_title: Off the rails: Monkey trouble disrupts Hong Kong’s MTR for second day in a row
en.topic_summary:
MTR services on the Tsuen Wan Line were disrupted on Friday for around an hour owing to a monkey on the tracks. It is the second primate-related transit incident in as many days.



Commuters observe an intruder on the tracks at Tsuen Wan station. Photo: MTRC.



Police and staff from the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department responded to reports of the monkey sighting at around 9am at Tsuen Wan station.



Normal services resumed at around 10am after the monkey was removed.



Monk
